source_corpus.source: GL3-015 persisted Signal API export, current evidence version per record

seed_contract: Dedicated disposable test schema reconstructs the three already-accepted GL3-016 source identities and exact retained corpus evidence. Baseline Signal power activity and rationale are reconstructed by production assess_permit from original corpus fields. No organization, person, title, contact or buying-chain claim is seeded. Reconstruction UUIDs are deterministic local IDs, not original physical Project UUIDs.
date_contract: Captured permit issue_date remains an event date; captured full permit and corporate sources have no publication date. Historical corpus publication dates are preserved without treating them as newly fetched source publication dates. Reconstructed original-evidence observed_at is execution time, not a claim about original corpus retrieval.
url_contract: The application exact-record query uses $limit=1; retained municipal capture uses $limit=5 and contains exactly the same single selected record. Both requested and captured URLs are recorded; no native HTTP byte equivalence is claimed.
